description: Pocket Guide to Transportation-Moving Goods Updated is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Provides a data-driven snapshot of the nation’s freight logistics infrastructure. This edition offers the latest statistics on tonnage, value, and ton-miles across all major modes, trucking, rail, water, air, and pipeline. It serves as an essential reference for policymakers and industry professionals to visualize the flow of commerce and the evolving demands on our supply chains. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 10 columns, among them Units, Visualization ID, Mode, Statistic, Year, Value. The portal shows 2026-06-09 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
